learn.title: Interactive Coding Sandbox
learn.subtitle: Test Angular v21 signals and control flow in real time. The sandbox engine loads lazily via control-flow defer blocks to save bundle bandwidth.
learn.signalsDesc: Signals track states changes directly in the DOM. Computed signals create derivative cached states, and effects react to signal changes.
learn.deferDesc: Angular @defer blocks defer loading of dependencies until trigger conditions (like viewport, timer, hover, idle) are met, accelerating initial bundle speeds.
